name: PadType
meaning: PS1 controller type id at Pad+0x57/+0x58 and in the high nibble of frame byte 1

name: PADTYPE_MOUSE
meaning: PS1 mouse (id 0x12). Only the debug free camera tests it (type nibble of Pad+0x2b == 1 at 0x552900), then reads +0x2e/+0x2f as signed deltas. Whether the PC input layer ever reports it is not checked.

name: PADTYPE_ANALOG
meaning: analog device; PS1 DualShock id 0x73. Enables the Pad_AnalogToStick paths
